A React root is attached to a host container; root.render displays the component tree there.
HTML එJක් root div එකට React app එක mount කරනවා. React root එJකන් app tree එක render
A Vite React app renders into div#root.
Read the diagram: The root owns the React tree inside its container.
Expected result: App UI appears inside the existing root element (assuming it exists).

Interview question: What does createRoot do?
Answer: It creates a React root for managing a component tree in a DOM container.
Remember: Root connects React to DOM.
Practice: Render a simple Hello component into #root.
